content: UK gov.uk gender pay gap guidance: quartile method sorts full-pay relevant employees high to low, splits into four equal groups, and where employees on a boundary share the same hourly pay the proportion of men and women on that pay must be the same in each quarter; leftover employees go to the lower quarter. Bonus gap uses ALL relevant employees, not only full-pay relevant employees, so the population differs between metrics. gov.uk updated the guidance on 21 May 2026 following a Supreme Court ruling on the definition of sex.
